company_name: Nanjing Sanchao Advanced Materials Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — the company specializes in manufacturing diamond and CBN tools used in semiconductor processing, particularly for cutting and polishing materials.
summary: Nanjing Sanchao Advanced Materials Co., Ltd. focuses on the research and development of diamond and CBN tools essential for the semiconductor industry. Their product offerings include backing grinding wheels, edge grinding wheels, micro blades, and electroplated diamond wire saws, which are critical for processing silicon and other hard materials.
capabilities: Backing grinding wheels for semiconductor applications
Edge grinding wheels for precision cutting
Electroplated diamond wire saws for high-quality slicing
technical_expertise: R&D for super hardness material processing
